# Ticket Statuses

Use one current status per ticket, updating it only through the agreed transition rules.

| Status | Meaning | Exit condition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Backlog | Not yet ready | Refined and prioritized |
| Ready | Can start | Owner begins work |
| In Progress | Being worked | Review requested |
| Review | Awaiting validation | Accepted or changes requested |
| Blocked | Waiting on an unresolved external dependency | Dependency resolved; return to prior active status |
| Done | Complete | No further work expected |
